thread.title: Magical Girl Raising Project restart • Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku restart - Episode 8 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoy the broader ensemble cast and the increased focus on character relationships.
Some viewers appreciate the shift toward mystery and find the quieter interactions engaging.
A few commenters see the slower approach as more substantial than the first season, while others feel it lacks that season’s intensity.
Some commenters describe the episode as boring and consider the season less emotionally or narratively impactful than its predecessor.
One recurring criticism is that certain characters feel underdeveloped or insufficiently important to the story.
